boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase campus and Claremont activities with direct free-access evidence.

cards.title: Scripps Student Garden
cards.subtitle: Behind Browning Hall, Scripps College
cards.notes: Meet up beside the vegetable beds, then look over the herb ring and grill area. Keep to shared garden areas and leave growing spaces undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A student-run edible garden and community space on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps describes the garden as a community space and edible garden, and its student-garden material calls it a free resource.
cards.access_notes: Use the outdoor community areas; gardening meetings and workshops may have separate participation details.

cards.title: Move at Tiernan Field House
cards.subtitle: Scripps College campus
cards.notes: Bring your 5C ID for a casual workout, swim, or court session. Check the facility schedule before going because access and guest rules vary.
cards.short_summary: Scripps students have free membership for the campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps lists student membership at Tiernan Field House as free.
cards.source_title: Tiernan Field House Membership, Daily Use, and Guest Prices
cards.access_notes: Free for Scripps students; facility schedules, age requirements, and guest policies apply.

cards.title: See an exhibition at Williamson Gallery
cards.subtitle: 251 East Eleventh Street, Scripps College
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition with a friend, then use the courtyard outside as a natural conversation break. Confirm exhibition dates before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A campus art gallery with rotating exhibitions and free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ruth Chandler Williamson Gallery states that it is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open during exhibitions Wednesday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; verify exhibition dates first.

cards.entity_name: Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.title: Browse the Benton Museum
cards.subtitle: 120 West Bonita Avenue, Claremont
cards.notes: Take in the current galleries at your own pace, then pause in the museum courtyard. Check the museum calendar for exhibition changes and closing days.
cards.short_summary: Pomona College’s art museum is a nearby free public exhibition stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona College says the Benton Museum remains free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Support the Benton Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: The museum publishes current hours and exhibition information on its visit pages.

cards.title: Visit the Clark Humanities Museum
cards.subtitle: Humanities Building, Scripps College
cards.notes: Plan a quiet visit around the current student-curated exhibition, then discuss one object that caught your attention. The museum’s listed hours are weekday daytime hours.
cards.short_summary: A Scripps teaching museum with current exhibitions and student access.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps lists the Clark Humanities Museum as open to all Claremont College students, faculty, and staff; a Scripps exhibition notice states admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Core II Student Exhibition at Clark Humanities Museum
cards.access_notes: Current museum information lists Monday–Friday hours and Claremont Colleges access; contact the museum for group or event visits.

cards.title: Catch a Friday Noon Concert
cards.subtitle: Balch Auditorium, Scripps College
cards.notes: Meet at Balch shortly before the performance and listen together for an hour. Check the current program and public-event protocol before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A daytime concert series presented at Scripps with free public admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps’ event calendar states that Friday Noon Concert Series admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The calendar directs visitors to the Friday Noon Concert page for current programs and public-event protocol.

cards.title: Reserve a Scripps Presents program
cards.subtitle: Scripps College venues
cards.notes: Choose a listed conversation, reading, or performance and reserve seats together. Arrive early enough to claim reserved seats before the release window.
cards.short_summary: Public arts and ideas programs that are generally free with reservations.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps says most Scripps Presents programs are free and open to the public, with reservations required.
cards.access_notes: Most programs require a reservation; individual events, capacity limits, and accessibility arrangements may differ.

cards.title: Attend a Goudy Lecture
cards.subtitle: Scripps College Press, Scripps College
cards.notes: Pick a scheduled talk from the Scripps College Press archive and bring a friend interested in books, print, or visual culture. Confirm the event details first.
cards.short_summary: A public Scripps College Press lecture series focused on book arts and related work.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps College Press states that the Frederic W. Goudy Lecture series is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Use the lecture page to confirm a scheduled date, location, and any event-specific instructions.

cards.title: Hear Fourth Saturdays Poetry
cards.subtitle: Claremont Helen Renwick Library, 208 North Harvard Avenue
cards.notes: Set aside a Saturday afternoon for the featured poets or an open mic, then browse the library afterward. Buying books is optional and not needed to attend.
cards.short_summary: A recurring local poetry series at the Claremont library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Friends of the Claremont Library states that Fourth Saturdays Poetry Readings are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The series lists upcoming readings at 2 p.m.; check the event page for the current date and speakers.

cards.title: Join an On the Same Page event
cards.subtitle: Claremont Helen Renwick Library and community venues
cards.notes: Use the selected community-read title as a prompt, then attend one of the related talks or discussions. Borrowing or buying the book is not required for event entry.
cards.short_summary: A citywide shared-reading program with free public events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Friends of the Claremont Library states that all Claremont: On the Same Page events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Check the current community-read page for scheduled events and venue details.
